annotations.title: Check a French VAT number in VIES

description: Checks live in VIES, the European Commission's VAT register, whether a French VAT number (or the VAT number of a SIREN or SIRET) is valid, with the name and address declared for VAT, crossed with the French registry: company active, insolvency proceeding, and a name_matches consistency signal between the VIES name and the registered name (not a proof of ownership). To confirm the number belongs to a given company, compare the returned names with that company's name. Pass requester_vat (the user's own EU VAT number) to get a VIES consultation number, proof of the check. vies.status 'unavailable' means VIES could not answer: try again later, it does not mean invalid.

number.description: FR VAT number, SIREN or SIRET; spaces allowed

requester_vat.description: The user's own EU VAT number, e.g. DE811569869, for a consultation number

name: check_vat
